sources.title: Multi-step LRU: SIMD-based Cache Replacement for Lower Overhead and Higher Precision
sources.snippet: A key-value cache is a key component of many services to provide low-latency and high-throughput data accesses to a huge amount of data. To improve the end-to-end performance of such services, a key-value cache must achieve a high cache hit ratio with high throughput.
